theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  classical
  have h_subset_or_compl : ∀ A : Set S, A ∈ P ∨ Aᶜ ∈ P := by grind
  have h₁ : P.card = Pᶜ.card := by
    refine Finset.card_bij (fun A => Aᶜ) ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro A hA
      simp only [Finset.mem_compl]
      intro hAc
      exact hPP A hA Aᶜ hAc (by simp)
    · intro A hA B hB h
      exact compl_inj_iff.mp h
    · intro B hB
      refine ⟨Bᶜ, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rcases h_subset_or_compl B with hB' | hB'
        · exact False.elim ((by simpa [Finset.mem_compl] using hB) hB')
        · exact hB'
      · simp
  have h₃ : 2 * P.card = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    have h₂ : P.card + Pᶜ.card = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
      rw [Finset.card_compl, Fintype.card_set]
      have hle : P.card ≤ 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
        simpa [Fintype.card_set] using Finset.card_le_univ P
      omega
    omega
  have hpow : 2 ^ Fintype.card S = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 := by
    have hn : 1 ≤ Fintype.card S := by
      have := Fintype.card_pos (α := S)
      omega
    rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel hn, pow_succ]
  rw [hpow] at h₃
  rw [mul_comm] at h₃
  exact Nat.mul_right_cancel h₃
